questions.question: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number-pair that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

**Except option 1, in all other options 2nd number is divisible by 1st number.**

By checking options:

**(1) 7 : 360 → 360 ÷ 7 = 51.43 → not a whole number, means 360 is not divisible by 7.**

(2) 6 : 222 → 222 ÷ 6 = 37 → whole number, means 222 is divisible by 6.

(3) 11 : 1342 → 1342 ÷ 11 = 122 → whole number, means 1342 is divisible by 11.

(4) 12 : 1740 → 1740 ÷ 12 = 145 → whole number, means 1740 is divisible by 12.

Hence, **7 : 360 **is the odd one.

questions.question:
Direction: Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Trump : Bridge
questions.solution:
Given: Trump : Bridge

The logic follows here is:

Trump is an action while playing Bridge (card game).

By checking the options:

(1) Header : Cycling → Cycling doesn't include header.

(2) Crank : Polo → Polo doesn't include crank.

(3) Pinching : Swimming → Swimming doesn't include pinching.

**(4) Dribble : Football → Football includes dribbling. Dribbling is an attacking move, where the player should retain the ball with them, until the opponent is defeated. **

Hence, dribble : **Football** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**Dribbling, as the science of working the ball along the ground by means of the feet is technically termed.” (**From the Football Annual, 1868.**)

It was inevitable that with the American invention of basketball in the early 1890s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__****Trump** means (in bridge, whist, and similar card games) play a trump on (a card of another suit).

**Header** means a shot or pass made with the head.

**Crank** means give a bend to (a shaft, bar, etc.).

**Pinching **means grip (something, typically a person's flesh) tightly and sharply between finger and thumb.

Dribbling means (in soccer, hockey, and basketball) an act of taking the ball forward with repeated slight touches or bounces.

questions.question:
**Direction**: From the given options choose the one in which the set of numbers do not follow the same Logic/Rule/Relation as the numbers given in below set.

(13, 9, 117)
Vishal divided an amount of ₹1,122 among his four friends A, B, C and D in the ratio of 11 : 17 : 14 : 9, respectively. How many more rupees did B get than D?
questions.solution:
Given: Vishal divided an amount of ₹1,122 among his four friends A, B, C and D in the ratio of 11 : 17 : 14 : 9.

Total amount = ₹1,122

Let the common factor be 'A'.

Then, according to the question,

11A + 17A + 14A + 9A = 1122

51A = 1122

A = 1122 ÷ 51

A = 22

Therefore, 

B get = 17A = 17 × 22 = ₹374 

D get = 9A = 9 × 22 = ₹198

Difference = 374 - 198 = ₹176.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**11 + 17 + 14 + 9 = 51

1122 ÷ 51 = 22

B - D = 17 - 9 = 8

Difference = 8 × 22 = ₹176

Hence, B get** ₹176** more than D.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number.

14 : 49 : : ? : 256 : : 20 : 100
questions.solution:
Given: 14 : 49 : : ? : 256 : : 20 : 100

The logic follows here is: 

14 : 49 **→ sqrt{49} = 7 → 2 times 7 = 14**

20 : 100 **→ sqrt{100} = 10 → 2 times 10 = 20**

Similarly,

**? : 256 → sqrt{256} = 16 → 2 times 16 = 32**

Hence, **32 **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

r _ l _ q r p _ b q _ p l b _ r _ l _ q

options.text: p, b, l, r, q, p, b
p, p, l, b, r, q, b
p, l, b, q, r, b, p
​l, p, q, b, r, p, b

questions.solution:
By checking options:

(1) p, b, l, r, q, p, b → r **p** l **b** q / r p **l **b q / **r** p l b **q **/ r** p** l **b** q

Here **__r p l b q__ is repeated.**

(2) p, p, l, b, r, q, b → r **p** l **p** q / r p **l** b q / **b** p l b **r **/ r **q** l **b** q

(3) p, l, b, q, r, b, p → r **p** l** l** q / r p **b** b q / **q** p l b** r** / r **b** l **p** q

(4) ​l, p, q, b, r, p, b → r **l** l **p** q / r p **q** b q / **b** p l b** r** / r** p** l **b** q

Option (1) gives a pattern of **r p l b**** q** - r p l b q - **r p l b q** - r p l b q.

Hence, **p, b, l, r, q, p, b** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Direction: Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All cups are plates.

All plates are spoons.

Conclusions:

I. All plates are cups.

II. Some spoons are neither plates nor cups.

III. No spoon is a cup.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53eaaaaa2ad80ecfba44a2b7eed6a5d8e53b2db611806471e9c4e4714b59e108.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All plates are cups → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

II. Some spoons are neither plates nor cups → False (it is possible but not definite)

III. No spoon is a cup → False (as some spoons are cups as shown in the diagram above)

Hence, none of the conclusions follow.
